title: PDV Experience Mode (Wayfarer's Path vs Pilgrim's Path) CK record and wiring plan
notes: This manifest records the CK/xEdit contract for the user-facing experience-mode toggle. Design lock lives in references/PDV_ExperienceMode_DesignReference.md.

pdv_author cannot mint new GlobalVariable or Quest records. The record-minting plan that closes that gap is at references/authoring/PDV_ExperienceMode_RecordSpec.md (a small Mutagen-based tool modelled on tools/pdv-stance-author/, recommended). Once the records exist, this manifest's operations[] apply the script attachments and property wiring as a reversible overlay.

The PDV_ModePreset script is the single owner of the preset scalars. Other scripts (PDV__ManagerQuest, PDV_ActionRouter, PDV_MCM) consume those scalars at the integration slots named in the design reference.
Default PDV.Mode value is 0 (Pilgrim's Path) so authored behavior is preserved on first read.
unsupported: Create GlobalVariable record PDV_GLO_Mode with Type=Short and InitialValue=0. Used as the CK-Condition mirror of PDV.Mode (0 = Pilgrim's Path, 1 = Wayfarer's Path).

Create Quest record PDV_ModePreset as a hidden start-game-enabled persistent quest with no aliases. Attach script PDV_ModePreset (see references/PDV_ExperienceMode_DesignReference.md Section 4 for canonical source). Properties: PDV_Manager -> PDV__ManagerQuest, PDV_GLO_Mode -> PDV_GLO_Mode.
Extend PDV_MCM quest with the third 'Experience Mode' page handler. Add property PDV_ModePresetRef -> PDV_ModePreset on the existing PDV_MCM script attachment.

Extend PDV__ManagerQuest script attachment with property PDV_ModePresetRef -> PDV_ModePreset and apply the in-script integrations in AwardPietyInternal (post-stance gain multiplier) and ProcessDawn (per-dawn ceiling scalar, decay/grace scalars when v3 decay slot is implemented).

Extend PDV_ActionRouter script attachment with property PDV_ModePresetRef -> PDV_ModePreset and gate the cheap-repeatable signal rejection branch on AllowCheapRepeatables(); apply CheapRepeatableWeight() to admitted dispatches.

operations.note: Manager reference is required for the StorageUtil PDV.Mode key, which lives on PDV__ManagerQuest as Form.
Mirror global for CK Condition reads. Refreshed by SetMode().
Wires the Experience Mode page toggle to the preset resolver.
Used by AwardPietyInternal (post-stance gain scalar) and ProcessDawn (per-dawn ceiling, decay step, grace window) integrations.
Used by the cheap-repeatable signal gate (AllowCheapRepeatables + CheapRepeatableWeight).
